root = Stack([title, recommendation, kpiRow, comparisonCard, revenueCard, conclusion], "column", "l", "stretch")
title = TextContent("Checkout Variant Comparison", "large-heavy")
recommendation = Callout("success", "Recommendation: Ship Variant D", "Express pay first delivers the highest conversion rate, lowest bounce rate, and highest expected revenue per session despite a lower average order value. Validate the result with a longer test before full rollout.")
kpiRow = Stack([bestConversion, bestRevenue, lowestBounce], "row", "m", "start", "start", "start", true)
bestConversion = Card([TextContent("Best conversion", "small"), TextContent("3.9%", "large-heavy"), TextContent("Variant D", "small")])
bestRevenue = Card([TextContent("Best expected revenue/session", "small"), TextContent("$1.91", "large-heavy"), TextContent("Variant D", "small")])
lowestBounce = Card([TextContent("Lowest bounce", "small"), TextContent("35%", "large-heavy"), TextContent("Variant D", "small")])
comparisonCard = Card([comparisonHeader, comparisonTable])
comparisonHeader = CardHeader("Performance comparison", "Two-week test with approximately 12,000 sessions per variant")
comparisonTable = Table([variantCol, conversionCol, orderCol, bounceCol, revenueCol])
variantCol = Col("Variant", variants)
conversionCol = Col("Conversion", conversions, "number")
orderCol = Col("Average order", averageOrders, "number")
bounceCol = Col("Bounce rate", bounces, "number")
revenueCol = Col("Expected revenue/session", revenuePerSession, "number")
revenueCard = Card([revenueHeader, revenueChart])
revenueHeader = CardHeader("Expected revenue per session", "Conversion rate × average order value")
revenueChart = BarChart(variants, [revenueSeries], "grouped", "Checkout variant", "Revenue per session", 300)
revenueSeries = Series("Expected revenue/session", revenuePerSession)
conclusion = TextCallout("info", "Interpretation", "Variant D is the strongest business choice: it generates approximately 14% more revenue per session than control ($1.91 vs. $1.67), a 0.8 percentage-point conversion lift, and a 6-point bounce reduction. Variant C has the highest order value, but its weaker conversion makes it second on expected revenue per session. Variant B improves conversion and bounce, but its lower order value leaves it slightly behind C.")
variants = ["A — Control", "B — One-page", "C — Trust badges", "D — Express pay first"]
conversions = [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9]
averageOrders = [54, 51, 56, 49]
bounces = [41, 37, 40, 35]
revenuePerSession = [1.674, 1.836, 1.848, 1.911]
